description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee salary components within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting salary components, along with validation rules and supporting logic for direct deposit details and pay grade validation.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing employee salary components, supporting CRUD operations, validation, and related business logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee's salary component by employee number and salary component ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all salary components for a specific employee, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new salary component for a specific employee, including optional direct deposit information.

methods.name: setEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeSalary entity with data from request parameters, including validation against pay grade and currency constraints.

methods.name: setEmployeeDirectDebitToEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Associates direct deposit details with an EmployeeSalary if specified in the request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee's salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing salary components.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new salary component.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Common validation rules used for create and update requests, including conditional validation for direct deposit fields.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee salary component, including validation and direct deposit handling logic.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an employee salary component.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more salary components for a specific employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting salary components.
